out.detail: Injured: lower body (surgery in August, will miss first month of season)

away.summary: The Florida Panthers open the 2026-27 season as defending Stanley Cup champions, facing the Hurricanes in the season opener. They are projected to start Jacob Markstrom in goal, with Akira Schmid as backup. Key absences include forwards Brad Marchand (lower-body surgery) and Jonah Gadjovich (upper-body surgery), both out indefinitely, while defenseman Uvis Balinskis is scratched. The lineup features their core of Barkov, Tkachuk, Reinhart, and Ekblad, aiming to begin the title defense on the road.

out.detail: Injured: shoulder (surgery in June, not expected to return until late October at earliest)

home.summary: The Carolina Hurricanes begin the 2026-27 season as defending Stanley Cup champions, hosting the Panthers in the opener. They are projected to start Brandon Bussi in goal, with Pyotr Kochetkov as backup. The team has trimmed its roster and assigned several prospects (Nadeau, Sorum, Valimaki, Fransen) to the AHL, with Jarvis placed on injured non-roster due to shoulder surgery. Key scratches for the opener include Kotkaniemi, Reilly, and Primeau. The Hurricanes aim to rely on their core of Aho, Svechnikov, and Staal, with recent preseason showing strong form from lines featuring Hall, Stankoven, and Blake.
